source_text: We hit the motherlode!

structure.raw_value: HrWoAg.Wait, 1Hero! Don’t touch anything!

source_text: What? Something wrong?

structure.raw_value: McShCl.What? Something wrong?

source_text: It’s Tikpak treasure. It’s all cursed.

structure.raw_value: HrSaEx.It’s Tikpak treasure. It’s all cursed.

translation: To skarb Tikpak. Wszystko jest przeklęte.

source_text: Cursed?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Cursed?

source_text: Remember what happened to the Guild? This must be where they put the cursed treasure they still had.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx.Remember what happened to the Guild? This must be where they put the cursed treasure they still had.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx.Remember what happened to the Guild? This must be where they put the cursed treasure they still had."

translation: Pamiętasz, co stało się z Gildią? To musi być miejsce, gdzie schowali przeklęty skarb, który im został.

source_text: So… I can’t take any of it?

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.So… I can’t take any of it?
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.So… I can’t take any of it?"

source_text: I’m afraid not, unless you want a first-row seat to the fate of the Eclipse Guild’s members.

structure.raw_value: HrBaDe.I’m afraid not, unless you want a first-row seat to the fate of the Eclipse Guild’s members.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaDe.I’m afraid not, unless you want a first-row seat to the fate of the Eclipse Guild’s members."

translation: Obawiam się, że nie, chyba że chcesz bilet w pierwszym rzędzie na los członków Gildii Eclipse.

source_text: That doesn’t sound appealing.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.That doesn’t sound appealing.

source_text: But then what’s the key for, the one Tasha has?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.But then what’s the key for, the one Tasha has?

source_text: Maybe there’s something more.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Maybe there’s something more.

source_text: Sounds good to me. I’m already dead, so it’ll be your funeral.

structure.raw_value: HrFlEx.Sounds good to me. I’m already dead, so it’ll be your funeral.
structure.script_literal: "HrFlEx.Sounds good to me. I’m already dead, so it’ll be your funeral."

source_text: Don’t be so dramatic.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Don’t be so dramatic.

source_text: I doubt Duncan kept a key around for a treasure he didn’t want to touch anyway.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I doubt Duncan kept a key around for a treasure he didn’t want to touch anyway.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I doubt Duncan kept a key around for a treasure he didn’t want to touch anyway."

translation: Wątpię, by Duncan trzymał klucz do skarbu, którego i tak nie chciał tknąć.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.He’s crazy enough to try killing me, but he’s not suicidal.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.He’s crazy enough to try killing me, but he’s not suicidal."

source_text: So Duncan tried to kill you, too, huh?

structure.raw_value: HrBaDe.So Duncan tried to kill you, too, huh?
structure.script_literal: "HrBaDe.So Duncan tried to kill you, too, huh?"

translation: Więc Duncan też próbował cię zabić, huh?

source_text: Wait, what? He tried to kill you?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Wait, what? He tried to kill you?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Wait, what? He tried to kill you?"

source_text: And succeeded.

structure.raw_value: HrAnDe.And succeeded.

source_text: Then Evie brought me back.

structure.raw_value: HrFrEx.Then Evie brought me back.

source_text: Your dad’s a real jerk.

structure.raw_value: HrAnOp.Your dad’s a real jerk.

source_text: You’ll get no argument from me.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.You’ll get no argument from me.

source_text: Evie brought you back, huh?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Evie brought you back, huh?

source_text: Why didn’t she do it again?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Why didn’t she do it again?

source_text: My time was up, I guess.

structure.raw_value: HrSaDe.My time was up, I guess.

source_text: That’s too bad, man.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.That’s too bad, man.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Just so you know, I’m grateful for your sacrifice.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Just so you know, I’m grateful for your sacrifice."

source_text: It was my fate… We all did what we had to do.

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp.It was my fate… We all did what we had to do.

source_text: So how long do you plan to live in the crystal? Forever?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.So how long do you plan to live in the crystal? Forever?

translation: Więc jak długo planujesz mieszkać w krysztale? Na zawsze?

source_text: I haven’t really thought about it.

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp.I haven’t really thought about it.

source_text: A lot of lovely ladies were left behind, and I want to spend more time with them.

structure.raw_value: HrFrEx.A lot of lovely ladies were left behind, and I want to spend more time with them.
structure.script_literal: "HrFrEx.A lot of lovely ladies were left behind, and I want to spend more time with them."

translation: Sporo ślicznych pań zostało w tyle i chcę spędzić z nimi więcej czasu.

source_text: I can understand that.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I can understand that.

source_text: So after they move on?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.So after they move on?

source_text: Depends on whether any of them will be joining me in Hell.

structure.raw_value: HrFlEx.Depends on whether any of them will be joining me in Hell.
structure.script_literal: "HrFlEx.Depends on whether any of them will be joining me in Hell."

source_text: What about kids?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What about kids?

source_text: Yeah… Definitely have several on the way.

structure.raw_value: HrFrOp.Yeah… Definitely have several on the way.
structure.script_literal: "HrFrOp.Yeah… Definitely have several on the way."

source_text: I’m not sure what I’ll do about them.

structure.script_literal: "HrWoOp.I’m not sure what I’ll do about them."

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.That’s tough. I don’t envy your position.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.That’s tough. I don’t envy your position."

source_text: Who knows? Could already have one or two of my own on the way, too.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Who knows? Could already have one or two of my own on the way, too.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Who knows? Could already have one or two of my own on the way, too."

source_text: Haha, yeah they are.

structure.raw_value: McFrOpNo3.Haha, yeah they are.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I’ve seen this before…

source_text: Henry, can you stand on this pressure plate?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Henry, can you stand on this pressure plate?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Henry, can you stand on this pressure plate?"

translation: Henry, możesz stanąć na tej płycie naciskowej?

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx.So have I… That’s not the problem.

structure.raw_value: HrFlDe.Now you get it.

structure.raw_value: HrFrOp.Nice work, Detective Canmore.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.That would suck… But I trust you.
